Yes — taken together, everything we've walked through fits and matches what I had in my head. Saving from just a URL and having the details filled in, fixing those details or the address later, my own formatted notes, reusable labels with suggestions, clicking a label to filter and clearing back out, the search in all its forms, the read-later pile with marking things read, and the sorting — they all hang together as one coherent way of working. Nothing contradicts anything else, and moving between them feels natural.

I'm happy with this as the core of it. I'll say honestly that there are still a few everyday things in my head we haven't touched yet — like removing a bookmark I no longer want, and what should happen if I try to save a link I've already saved — but those are for when you're ready to go there. For what we've actually reviewed, it's right.
